name: area-chart
title: Area chart
description: A value over time as filled areas, one or several series, with a legend, tooltip and data table.

when: A total and its trend over time.

instead.when: Several series are compared, not summed.
Periods are compared as discrete values.

keyboard.does: Moves between data points; the tooltip follows.

builtIn: A "Show as table" button shows the same data as a table, which screen readers get by default.
youProvide: A title that says what the figure is.

genui.description: A trend over time. Rows are periods; categories are the numeric columns drawn (at most five).

title.description: What the chart shows ("Revenue"), over it; leave it out when a card or a heading already says so.

index.description: The x key: the period or category of each row.

categories.description: The series keys, in order; the first is the product's own figure (`ds-chart-1`).

AreaChart.name: tableView
AreaChart.description:
How the data is offered as a table. `swap` (default): a toggle at the end of the chart's top row turns the plot
into the table at the same height, scrolling inside, so the card never grows. `hidden`: no toggle; the table is
there for screen readers only. `none`: no table at all, for a chart that is already text (BarList).

AreaChart.name: isTableOpen
AreaChart.description: The table is showing (`swap`), controlled; or `defaultTableOpen` + `onTableOpenChange`.

AreaChart.name: title
AreaChart.description: What the chart shows ("Revenue"), over it; leave it out when a card or a heading already says so.

AreaChart.name: aria-label
AreaChart.description: Names the chart when it has no visible `title` (a card's heading already says what it shows).

AreaChart.name: index
AreaChart.description: The x key: the period or category of each row.

AreaChart.name: categories
AreaChart.description: The series keys, in order; the first is the product's own figure (`ds-chart-1`).

AreaChart.name: labels
AreaChart.description: Series names by key ("web" → "Website"); the key by default.

AreaChart.name: valueFormatter
AreaChart.description: Shared by axis, tooltip and table (Intl): "€ 48.920".

AreaChart.name: indexFormatter
AreaChart.description: The index label in the tooltip and the table ("August 2026").

AreaChart.name: indexLabel
AreaChart.description: The index column's header in the data table; "Period" for time charts, "Category" for BarChart.

AreaChart.name: height
AreaChart.description: The plot's height in px; 240 by default.

AreaChart.name: emptyState
AreaChart.description: Shown instead of the plot when there is no data: an `EmptyState size="small"` or text; "No data" by default.

AreaChart.name: allowDecimals
AreaChart.description:
`false` for whole counts (orders, new customers): the value axis steps by whole numbers, so a small count
reads 0 / 1 / 2 / 3, never 0.7 / 1.4 / 2.1. Fractional steps by default. Percent bars keep their
0–100% steps.

AreaChart.name: comparison
AreaChart.description: The previous period's key: a dashed `ds-chart-neutral` line without fill.

AreaChart.name: yAxisWidth
AreaChart.description: The value axis' width in px; by default wide enough for its longest tick (48–128px).

AreaChart.name: onValueChange
AreaChart.description: A pointer press on the chart: the row under it (keyboard users read values in the tooltip and the table).

AreaChart.name: referenceLines
AreaChart.description: A target or an average (an MRR goal): dashed `ds-border-bold` with a label at its end; the axis reaches it.
